oneLineCopy: From offer to paying customer — without a shop project.

hero.headlineSerifLead: Product, price, checkout and invoice — said once, ready to sell, tax and settlement included.

founderScenario.story: The offer has been ready for three weeks. What's missing is the path from "I want that" to paid: set up the payment provider, configure the product, check the tax rates, automate the invoice. Samuel has set Saturday aside for it. For the fourth time.

benefits: A product is spoken and ready to sell — no shop project first
Payment, invoice and receipt happen in one move
Subscriptions, one-offs and deposits without an extra tool
VAT stated correctly, across borders too
Every sale lands in your bookkeeping, not in an export file
howSteps: You tell your Aven what you sell and at what price
It creates product, price and checkout — wired to your payment provider
The link exists: your own page, a landing page, or straight in a conversation
Paid means: invoice out, receipt filed, booking prepared

whatMechanics.input: Your product, your price, your payment provider
whatMechanics.magic: Product and price setup → checkout flow → tax logic → invoice and receipt → handover to bookkeeping
whatMechanics.output: A payable link · an automatic invoice · a clean receipt in the stack

playsWith.relation: Der Checkout sitzt dort, wo dein Angebot steht
Jeder Verkauf ist sofort in deinen Zahlen sichtbar
Belege sind gebucht, bevor du daran denkst
Preisänderungen gehen erst live, wenn du sie bestätigst

valueStack.timeDelayToValue: The first buy button exists inside the same conversation
valueStack.effortToInstall: Connect a payment provider — the rest you tell your Aven
valueStack.proof: The avenID is sold through checkout builder. The same path you're about to walk.

bonuses: Vouchers and early-bird prices without rebuilding anything
Subscription handling: cancel, pause, switch — without a ticket reaching you
A sale notification that tells you who bought and why it matters
letterFromPublisher: Between a good offer and the first euro there are usually no doubts, only steps. Four Saturdays Samuel reserved and never used. I turn the offer into a link. The customer does the rest.
